title: Concept: Legacy cipher with openssl enc -des3 -in backup.tar -out backup.enc (shell) — review required
description: In shell build or script text, openssl enc -des3 -in backup.tar -out backup.enc selects a single DES family cipher. DES keys are short enough to brute force and the mode provides no integrity, so protected data is recoverable and tampering is silent. Re-encrypt with an authenticated cipher and passphrase KDF (a modern authenticated cipher).
applicability: Dockerfiles and shell scripts that run openssl enc; lexical scope.
risk: Recoverable ciphertext and undetected modification; MEDIUM severity.
